_comment: Everything the host (Monty) says, plus short status lines for phones. {placeholders} are filled in by the game. Add variants freely; one is picked at random.

lobbyWelcome: Evening. I'm Monty. Grab your phones and scan the code. Yes, all of you. Even you.
Welcome to Quippy. Scan the code, type your name, and try to be funnier than last time. Low bar.
Righto. Phones out, codes scanned. The sooner we start, the sooner I can go home.
join: {name} is in. The bar has been set. Somewhere.
And here's {name}, fresh from the servo.
audienceJoin: {name} has joined the audience. Judge harshly.
{name} is in the audience. Your vote counts. Not much, but it counts.
needMorePlayers: We need at least {min} players. Go and find a friend. Or a neighbour. Or a bot.
Not enough players. I need {min}. I can wait. I'm paid by the hour.
intro: Welcome to {game}. Two of you get the same prompt. Everyone else picks the funnier answer. Try not to embarrass yourselves.
This is {game}. Write something funny on your phone. Everyone votes. Somebody wins. Everybody else goes home and thinks about what they've done.
{game}. Answer the prompts on your phone, then vote on everyone else's. Simple. Unlike some of you.
round1Intro: Round one. Look at your phones and get writing.
Round one. Check your phones. Be quick. Be funny. Pick one if you must.
round2Intro: Round two. Points are doubled, so are the stakes. Mostly the points.
Round two. Double points. Your chance to make up for round one.
finalRoundIntro: Final round. Everyone gets the same prompt. Everyone votes. Leave nothing in the tank.
The Final Showdown. One prompt, all of you. Make it count.
answerStart: Your prompts are on your phones. The clock is ticking. So is my patience.
Off you go. Write something your mum wouldn't be ashamed of. Or would. Your call.
readAnswers: On one hand, "{a}". On the other, "{b}".
win: {name} wins that. {other}, there's always next time. Statistically.
shutout: Shutout! Every single vote to {name}. {other}, I'm so sorry.
A clean sweep for {name}. {other}, go and have a little lie down.
Shutout! Nobody voted for {other}. Not even out of pity.
tie: A tie. How very diplomatic of you all.
Dead even. Nobody wins. Very Canberra of you.
forfeit: {other} didn't answer, so {name} wins by default. Not glamorous, but it counts.
{name} wins by forfeit. {other}, the phone works better when you type on it.
noVotes: No votes at all. I'll take that as stunned silence.
noContest: Neither of you answered. Truly a meeting of minds.
Two blank answers. A bold artistic statement.
scores: Here's the leaderboard. {leader} is out in front. {last}, you're... also here.
{leader} leads. Everyone else, try harder. Or at all.
Scores, please. {leader} on top, {last} bringing up the rear with dignity. Some dignity.
scoresClose: It's tight at the top. {leader} by a whisker.
Close one. {leader} leads, but only just. Anyone could take it. Even {last}.
scoresNewLeader: New leader! {leader} has taken the top spot.
Would you look at that. {leader} is leading now. Momentum is a funny thing.
finalAnswerStart: Final Showdown. Everyone, same prompt. Here it is.
One last prompt. All of you. Here we go.
finalVoteStart: Vote for your favourites. You get {n}. Not your own, nice try.
Time to vote. Pick your favourites. You can't vote for yourself, I checked.
finalReveal: Let's see how you voted. From the bottom up.
The results. Starting with the ones you'd rather forget.
gameOver: And the winner is {name}! Take a bow. Everyone else, take notes.
{name} wins! Enjoy it. It won't last.
Your champion is {name}. Somebody get them a sausage in bread.
gameOverTie: It's a tie! {name} share the crown. Awkward.
Joint winners: {name}. Very wholesome. I hate it.
cbLoadingAi: Monty is writing prompts about you. This could get personal.
Reading the Lore Book. Writing something rude. Please hold.
cbLoadingBuiltin: Remembering what you all said earlier. Unfortunately.
cbIntroWithLore: Welcome back to Callback Club. I remember everything. Especially "{joke}".
Callback Club. The Lore Book has {count} entries now, including "{joke}". We'll be bringing that up.
Ah, Callback Club. Where "{joke}" is never forgotten. Let's add to the pile.
cbIntroFresh: Welcome to Callback Club. I'll be writing prompts about you, and remembering everything you say. Everything.
Callback Club. Tonight I learn your running jokes. Next time, I use them against you.
phoneIntro: Get ready. Look at the big screen.
phoneAudienceWriting: The players are writing. Prepare your judging face.
Players are writing. You'll get to vote soon.
phoneAnswered: Done! Now act like you're still writing.
All in. Go get a drink while the slow ones finish.
phoneYourMatchup: That's your answer up there. Poker face.
phoneVoted: Thanks for voting. Probably the right call.
phoneWatchReveal: Eyes up. Results on the big screen.
phoneLost: Not your round. Shake it off.
